notes:
- **Mistral (Voxtral) can now be set up for speech, with speaker separation.** The Mistral tile in Speech services used to stop at "Mistral listed no chat models" because Mistral's model list wasn't read right, and nothing could be saved. It now opens with `voxtral-mini-latest` filled in, Test sends the short test clip and shows what it heard, and in Meeting notes Mistral labels the other people on a call so naming and voice tags work as with Deepgram. Your Dictionary words go along as spelling hints, and its price is in **Usage & cost**. The same list fix applies to Mistral under Language models. See [Speech models](/docs/speech-models/).
- **A service you can't test yet can still be saved.** If Test fails or can't run (no key yet), **Save** stays available and the tile says **Not tested yet:** with the reason, for speech and language services alike.
